items.a: Voice agent testing checks that an AI voice agent understands callers, responds quickly and completes the task, across voices, accents and noisy conditions.

items.q: How do you test an AI voice agent?
items.a: TestMu AI sends simulated callers to the agent over audio or real phone calls, then scores latency, transcription accuracy and task completion.

items.q: What latency is good for a voice agent?
items.a: TestMu AI rates response latency of 1,000 ms or less as excellent, up to 2,500 ms as good and above 2,500 ms as poor.

items.q: Can I test accents and background noise?
items.a: Yes. Choose from 200+ voices, 50+ accents and dialects, and background-noise presets.

items.q: Does it work with any voice AI vendor?
items.a: Yes. Tests run over a phone number or audio endpoint, so the agent can be built on any stack.
